name: anivora
description: Anime streaming platform built with MERN stack

scripts.miruro: docker start miruro-api || docker run -d --name miruro-api -p 3000:8000 miruro-api
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run miruro" "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
